in_short: Celaena Sardothien, Adarlan's most notorious assassin, has spent a year enslaved in the salt mines of Endovier when Crown Prince Dorian and Captain Chaol Westfall offer her a bargain: compete against other killers and thieves to become the King's Champion and, after years of service, earn her freedom. The favored competitor, the brutal Cain, grows unnaturally strong by summoning a monstrous creature. Weakened by a court poisoning plot, Celaena faces Cain in the final duel, defeats the creature he calls, and kills him, winning the title of King's Champion. recaps.text: Celaena Sardothien, the continent's most feared assassin, has been enslaved for a year in the deadly salt mines of Endovier. Crown Prince Dorian and Captain of the Guard Chaol Westfall arrive with an offer: enter a royal competition against other killers and thieves, and if she wins and serves the king as his Champion, she can eventually earn her freedom. Celaena accepts and is taken to the glass castle in the capital, where she trains under the wary, watchful Chaol and sizes up her rivals. Prince Dorian takes an interest in her that is more than professional, and Celaena begins to relearn a life beyond survival while hiding just how dangerous she truly is.

The competition proceeds through tests of skill and combat, and Celaena, forced to conceal her full abilities, works to stay near the top without drawing too much attention. She befriends Nehemia, a proud princess of the conquered kingdom of Eyllwe, and grows closer to both Dorian and Chaol. Then the contest turns sinister: competitors begin to be found horribly murdered, their bodies mutilated in ways no ordinary killer could manage. Unsettled, Celaena senses that something far worse than her rivals is loose in the castle, and she starts trying to understand what is hunting the Champions.

As the murders continue, Celaena investigates and finds strange markings connected to old, forbidden magic hidden in the castle. The ghost of Elena, the first queen of Adarlan, appears to her with cryptic warnings, insisting that an ancient evil is stirring and that Celaena is meant to stop it. Meanwhile the hulking competitor Cain grows unnervingly strong and confident, and Celaena begins to suspect that his rise and the killings are linked. Court intrigues tighten around her even as she races to understand the supernatural threat no one else will acknowledge.

Elena presses Celaena toward a hidden danger beneath the castle and reveals more of the dark forces at work, tying the murders to a summoned creature and the markings Celaena has been finding. As the final rounds of the competition approach, court schemers move against her, and Celaena is secretly poisoned to weaken her before the decisive duel. Caught between the contest, the intrigue, and the growing supernatural threat, she prepares to fight for her life and her freedom against a rival who is becoming something no longer entirely human.

The competition ends in a final duel, and Celaena faces Cain, who has been drawing unnatural power by summoning a monstrous creature through a portal opened with dark markings. Weakened by the poisoning, she is nearly killed, but with Elena's help she destroys the creature and kills Cain, winning the title of King's Champion. Her victory brings only a bound, conditional freedom: she must now serve the ruthless king she despises for years to come. Yet she is alive and out of Endovier, with Dorian, Chaol, and Nehemia as allies she has come to trust. The forbidden magic she uncovered, her own uneasy tie to it, and the king's deeper cruelties are left looming over what comes next.
